positions.name: Ethereum
positions.catalyst: ETH remains the momentum leader among the majors with the strongest active positive flow catalyst on the tape. Spot ETH ETFs added ~$365M in July — a sharp rebound after shedding ~$528M in June and ~$540M in May — and staking/ETF inflows continue to firm. ETH recovered off ~1,867 to ~1,894 today (Coinbase live), pressing the top of its established $1,750-1,980 August range and showing clear relative strength versus a flat BTC (~64.5k) and a technically weak SOL (stuck below its $77 pivot). Canonical dashboard proxy was STALE this run (asOf 2026-08-05T15:02:27Z, ~24h old), so entry/exit used a live Coinbase spot fallback per the runbook: ETH 1893.995, BTC 64538.685, SOL 73.615, pulled at run time ~2026-08-06T11:54Z.
positions.driver: Closed prior ETH at 1893.995 (Coinbase live fallback) vs entry 1875.08 for +105.61 (+1.01%) — ETH firmed overnight while the majors were mixed. RE-SELECTED ETH as the best risk-adjusted next-24h pick: it pairs momentum leadership with a concrete, still-positive ETH-specific flow catalyst (July ETF inflow rebound + staking demand) and shows the cleanest relative strength on the board. Wins vs runners-up: BTC is the safest major but is drifting flat near 64.5k with no catalyst edge; SOL has genuine catalysts (staking-enabled spot ETFs, Western Union Stablecard/USDPT issued on Solana, ongoing ETF inflows) but sits in a confirmed bearish structure below its $77 pivot with no momentum confirmation and higher beta — higher odds of getting stopped. ETH offers the asymmetric setup with a definable stop. 8% major stop keeps payoff asymmetric.
positions.risks: ETH is pressing the top of a multi-week range ($1,980 overhead resistance) and has faded intraday before; a failure to clear overhead plus a risk-off macro turn would cap the rally and drag ETH with the broad tape. ETF-flow leadership is a monthly aggregate, not a guarantee of next-24h follow-through. Dashboard price feed was stale this run — Coinbase live fallback used, which may differ slightly from the site's Yahoo feed. Hard stop 1742.48 (-8%).
